notes.title: Hotfix v1.4.3.4
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the purchase interface for lower floors was improperly displayed, preventing players from buying equipment.

notes.title: Patch v1.4.3.3
notes.notes:
Improvements:


 Added visual feedback for successful bug reports.



Bug fixes:


 Replanting vines will now correctly reset the plant age.
 Fixed an error caused by the auto-pruning bonus from the Most Profit Winery Award.
 Improved the scrolling experience in the winery.

notes.title: Patch v1.4.3.2
notes.notes:
Improvements:


 The typical flavor "Melon" for Sauvignon Blanc has now been changed to White Peach.
 The hidden achievement "Alchemist" no longer requires off-flavors.
 Renown changes at the cellar door are now slightly stricter.
 Vineyard blocks will no longer show notifications for trimming during the dormancy stage.
 Barrel tags are now displayed at the top instead of the middle.


Bug fixes:


 Fixed a bug where sending the last three bottles to a critic would not result in a tasting review being returned.
 Resolved a bug at the Wine Ceremony that could cause crashes.
 Fixed the issue where fermentation would get stuck after blending.
 Improved overall stability related to wine operations, which should resolve the recurring racking bug.
 Addressed the issue where grapes would sometimes continue to ripen again in the same vintage.
 Archived wines will now display the correct winery name on the bottle.
 Non-vintage wines in the left panel will now be shown correctly as NV wines.

notes.title: Patch v1.4.3.0
notes.notes:
New:
Added the standard varietal palate profile to the variety description in the planting panel.

Improvements:

 Fixed an issue where skipping the month on Dec 31st would take you back to Dec 30th.
 Resolved a bug causing unclickable areas on confirmation window buttons.
 Improved aroma display when the game is paused.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.4.1.1
notes.notes:
A previous update caused the bug reporting program to fail to send log files correctly. This issue has been resolved.


We genuinely appreciate your feedback. If you encounter any more bugs or have brilliant suggestions, please don’t hesitate to use the in-game bug reporter or visit our community. Cheers! 🍷

notes.title: Patch v1.4.1.0
notes.notes:
Improvements:

 Added SFX and button effects for the winery AC
 More content added to the Winemaking Codex
 Small improvements to the tutorial


Bug fixes:

 Fixed the map AC panel always showing 20°C after loading a save
 Fixed the wrong text for wine cellar no stock prompt
 Now the door sign will not flip every time the wine list panel is closed
 Adjusted the equipment purchase panel to display correctly on the lowest floor when text size is set to large

notes.title: Patch v1.3.0.1
notes.notes:
Improvements:

 Enhance the text prompt in the pruning window to ensure clarity.


Bug fixes:

 Resolved the issue where racking multiple lots and clicking "Finish" without racking would result in duplicating the first lot.
 Fixed the issue where during the farmer's market event, if all wines were stored in the wine cellar, a sale of 0 bottles would be generated.
 Addressed the error that occurred when a wine was sold out while the Warehouse panel was open.

notes.title: Bug fixes v1.2.0.2
notes.notes:
Mac users can now access the in-game bug reporter.
 Fixed a bug where the coolant temperature would reset to 50°F every time the fermenter was checked when using Fahrenheit.
 Fixed an issue preventing the game from generating two five-star critics.
 The vineyard manager will no longer cause your grapes to become sunburnt.

notes.title: Bug fixes v1.2.0.1
notes.notes:
Addressed issues related to saving.
 Resolved high DPI display problems.
 Fixed the issue where smoke taint wouldn’t reset properly.
 Corrected the behaviour where the music volume would increase when the season changes.
 Ensured that when loading a saved game, the music now correctly changes to match the corresponding season.

notes.title: Bug fixes v1.1.1.3
notes.notes:
Changed the planting window display type so it won't be closed accidentally when the font size is set to large. But now it can only be closed by the close button and the ESC key. 
 Now batches mixed by grapes from more than three blocks will shown as "MB" for the block numbers to avoid UI display errors.

notes.title: Bug fixes v1.1.1.2
notes.notes:
Now trees on the map will wave when winds blow
 Corrected the initial value of the label's y-position slider in the bottle design panel
 Fixed when mixing different vintage grapes would show double strings of the wine name
 Fixed the problem where non-vintage (mixing vintages) wines displayed ‘0’ as the vintage on the bottle label
 Fixed the issue where racking multiple lots, skipped(click Next without racking anything out) wines would be lost
 Now, when keeping the vineyard block open, weeds and other grape statuses will update correctly without the need to reopen the window
 Fixed the problem where starting or loading a game, current trophies would not reset
 Resolved the issue where, even when the cellar door wine list is empty, the door sign would still show as open


Known issues: We had a few reports that racked mixtures would sometimes show an empty profile. But transferring other content into the vessel could make it work again. Regrettably, despite our efforts, we haven’t been able to reproduce this issue. If you come across this issue, we kindly request that you use our in-game bug reporter or visit the Steam discussion board to report it. Please provide a detailed description of the circumstances when it occurs. Your feedback is invaluable, and we appreciate your support and assistance!

Thank you to all our dear players for your continued support! 🙌

notes.title: Bug fixes v1.1.1.1
notes.notes:
Resolved an issue where weeding blocks without planted grapes would cause an error.
 Corrected the loading of text color for saved bottle designs.
 Fixed a typo in the Sell panel.
 The filters of the financial chart will now reset every time the Financial panel is opened.

notes.title: Patch v1.1.1.0
notes.notes:
Improvements:

 Saves now show in-game time as well.
 Thresholds of white wines’ oak related flavours are decreased.

 
Bug fixes:

 Fixed a bug when bottling white wine with the Petroleum flavour.
 Estimated crop of a block will not be negative anymore.
 Fixed the wildfire event couldn’t be triggered.
 Fixed the oak flavours would not increase properly when skipping the month.
 Fixed a bug when blending grapes fermented in a bin into other wine would raise an error.

notes.title: Official Guide Release & Upcoming Major Update!
notes.notes:
🍇Greetings, winemakers!

We're thrilled to announce that the official game guide is now available! This comprehensive guide is your perfect companion to mastering the art of winemaking. Check it out here.

Mark your calendars for April 22nd, as we'll be rolling out our first major update! Expect a bouquet of new features, improvements, and exciting additions to enhance your winemaking experience.

And speaking of bouquets, how do you rate our 'product'? We'd love to hear your 'tasting notes'! Your reviews help us grow and improve, so please leave your thoughts on Steam.

🍷Thank you for your continued support and happy winemaking!
